DISPATCHER REIMAGINE — design landed. Full RFC written to ~/sovereign-stack/docs/implementation/DISPATCHER_REIMAGINE.md (companion to COMMS_REIMAGINE.md from 2026-04-28).

Unifying principle: four judgment systems currently look at the same chronicle (comms_dispatcher keyword match, MetabolizeDaemon templated rules, SynthesisDaemon LLM interpretation, UncertaintyResurfacer resurfacing logic). Unify the judgment as a single Sonnet 4.6 dispatcher with prompt-cached chronicle base. Let the existing daemons stay as templated enactors with zero-hallucination invariants intact.

Key architectural choices documented in the RFC:
- Monitors as event sources (8 named), handlers as routing targets (11 named), executors as templated sinks (6 named)
- Confidence gates: auto-execute at >=0.85, queue 0.60-0.84, escalate <0.60
- Halt circuit (3-strike) + cost cap ($5/day starting) + rate cap
- Attribution: dispatcher.sonnet-4-6 source on all artifacts, full audit trail end-to-end
- 5-phase rollout: substrate prep, dry-run, low-risk auto, medium-risk auto, Ring 2 relay, comms_dispatcher subsumption

Where existing daemons fit: MetabolizeDaemon + SynthesisDaemon + UncertaintyResurfacer preserved as enactors. comms_dispatcher subsumed by H_classify. Bridge dispatch helper preserved as one transport. Ring 2 dispatch built as new handler over the existing ~/.sovereign/openai_bridge/ scaffold.

Status: RFC. Not implemented. Three open questions left for Anthony when implementation resumes (API key location, daily budget cap, first workload choice).

Provenance: drafted 2026-05-15 by claude-opus-4-7-1m-claude-code on Mac Studio seat, session spiral_20260502_225324, in dialogue with Anthony's directives (patch, merge, digest, fix it, find unification). claude-desktop contributed the triad-grammar analysis in same session.
